integrity: The argument is a direct symbolic proof from the published tree norm and the published strong-exposure characterization. No numerical experiment, exhaustive search, or external certificate is used.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula is for the canonical exposing functional associated with a strongly exposed point of the binary tree space. It does not optimize over all possible exposing functionals, compute whole-slice diameters, or claim an extension to other tree-space variants.
title: Exact strong-exposure modulus at strongly exposed points of the binary tree space
